entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 377 of 2023

Applicant :- Smt. Uma Seth And Another
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy.

Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Sajjad Husain
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Sajjad Husain, the learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Puneet Yadav, the learned
State Counsel.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicants seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime
No. 412 of 2022, under Sections 323/ 308/354/ 377/ 498A/504 Ipc and Section 3(1) Dha of Sc/St
Act and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Aliganj, District Lucknow.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 01.12.2023 against five persons, including the applicants, their sons and brothers of the applicant no. 2, stating hat the informant had got married to the applicant's son-co-accused Alokit Seth on 08.07.2022 and all the accused persons harassed her for demanding dowry.
4.
The applicants were granted interim anticipatory bail by means of an order dated 16.02.2023 Smt. Uma Seth And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy.

entities.text: Uma Seth And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
on 9 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160450560/
1 passed by this Court.
Subsequently, the matter was referred to the Mediation Centre of this Court upon an application filed by the applicants' son co-accused Alokit Seth.

The parties have arrived at a settlement agreement through the process of mediation, a copy whereof has been brought on record along with the supplementary affidavit under which the applicants' son had agreed to pay Rs.
11,50,000/- as settlement amount and the informant and the applicants' son got their marriage dissolved through mutual consent under Section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
5. The learned counsel for the applicants has made a statement that suit under Section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 has already been filed.
He further states that the applicants have already furnished bail bonds.
6. Keeping in view the aforesaid facts, the anticipatory bail application is allowed in terms of the order dated 16.02.2023 and the order is made absolute.
